notes.title: Visual Update
notes.content:
Most of the 3D models went through changes and the best way to show it is a couple of images.

Let's see what's changed:

Resource buildings
All of the models went trough a complete rework. I wanted them to look like either a factory or a shop.
Videos of how those models were made, can be found on Debatto youtube channel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/3a04a1d99528048d0f28229a675742a38e98061d.png


Buildings placeholders
The idea behind this, is that buildings which aren't started yet, will look like blueprints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/900aa6269e0e6941df566ce482594f0a064bc543.png


Enviroment
Enviroment blocks now has bigger trees. It means that if You put them next to each other, they will cover adjacent block as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/60046ed3650a51a667abc0da1761ad305869899b.png


Upcomming new systems
There are a new systems upcoming. One is the ability to send cistern from HQ, which will refuel Your car. Second one is the car spoilage. You will have to send service car to repair the broken car.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/c4e47faedd8d4feebba0505df33f9cd8dde6bb2c.png


Headquarters building
Old HQ was really simple. Now it looks like a modern building!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/df2e741790435d21b6891d5dd4041381ee55b4dc.png


Roads
It might not be obvious at first look, but roads are now not a straight lines. Sidewalks are now bigger and there are also an crosswalks. This was made in a preparation of AI human population, which will walk on sidewalks. There are also thoughts about adding taxi cars which will help players making more money while they wait for resource cars to finish their current job.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/99a41f59adf81541e27b61153c2a6a5f1e034400.png


New shop UI
Completely new UI will help filtering vehicles by resource they can carry. It's also prepared to have any number of vehicles which can be added in future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/4d54db291430a122d6ac77987903dae0a86ad3f3.png



This isn't the end of visual changes. There are still more to come.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Release 1.2.0 - Fuel System
notes.content:
Christmas holidays stopped development so this is coming little bit later than expected. But here We are, new update is here and game has changed a lot. You interested what's new? A lot!

First of all game now has discord channel where You can put Your ideas, find players or get free key. 

Join if You wish to be part of the community: https://discord.gg/sNW99eWdhy


FUEL SYSTEM
New Fuel System. Cars has floating fuel bar above them and You need to refuel them at Fuel Stations which are randomly generated around city. If You fail to refuel, car will have speed reduced to 15% and You will have to slowly drive to Fuel Station.
Video from modeling: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-9FR0hIE6p8
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/59fce958d2ba005cb3f7070f695b3013a3eaa577.png


NEW UI
Completely new UI. All of the UI elements has been revisited and changed. Everything is now much smaller and takes less space so it doesn't disturb so much during gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/e0593411fbeac67fd51fd14722727e91591d47bb.png


NEW MODEL
Model for Dumper has been changed for new one as old one was little bit weird.
Video from modeling: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zOut0o72_FQ
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205371/89e2b41bf554b09628971cdf2e0bf573d003c98e.png


LOBBY CHANGES

 Players joining lobby through QUICK MATCH button are now automatically ready. They just have to choose their color.
 Team games are now disabled in QUICK MATCH as these players doesn't know each other and it will ruing their experience when another player uses all of their money.
 Added system messages to room chat for "player not ready" and "player didn't pick color". They are displayed when master clients clicks Play button.


OTHER

 Reduced resources needed for big buildings.
 Score panel is now hidden in solo games as score is displayed on top.

notes.title: Big Buildings are Now Live
notes.content:
As previously announced, "Big Buildings" are now live.

Big buildings are bringing different type of buildings. First of all, they are BIG.

Each tier of big building requires much more resources than standard buildings. Don't worry, money can't be stolen from You. Points and money are redistributed based on how much You helped to finish building.

Each building requires much more resources but they will pay off in long term. Finished building will start global boost based  on type of building.

Final list of buildings and boosts:

 Bazaar: Cars are cheaper by 30%.
 Car Service: Cars can hold 50% more resources.
 City Hall: Buildings are giving 20% more money.
 Driving School: Cars are faster by 15%.
 Train Station: Buildings requires 30% less resources.

notes.title: Upcoming: Big Buildings
notes.content:
I would like to share that work has started on upcoming new feature called "big buildings".

These buildings will cover land size of 3x3. They can be builded by all players and each player will get share of money and points depending on how much he contributed to current building tier.

After completing the building all players will get global modifier. Currently there are six different buildings. They might still change but let's look at what modifiers they will give:


 Hospital: cars can't be broken
 Driving school: cars are faster by 15%
 Train station: all buildings requires less resources by 30%
 Car service: cars will carry 20% more resources
 City hall: buildings are giving 20% more money
 Car bazaar: cars are cheaper by 20%


Each building will require much more resources than standard buildings and they will go through same 5 phases.

notes.title: Upcoming features after release
notes.content:
Some of these might or might not be implemented. Everything depends on feedback.

Upcoming features:

 Cars will have fuel and there will be fuel stations around city. If You forget to fuel Your car, You will have to send "cistern car" from Your HQ.
 Possibility to build resource buildings.
 Big common massive buildings, covering multiple tiles instead of one.
 Random storms across city, which will cover that part and You will be unable to build there for a moment.
 Random fires on buildings, which will lower tier of building if not cleared.
 Random breakdowns of cars. Cars will be fixed by service car, sent from HQ.
 Air transport?


All of these features aren't coming in any particular order.
